annotations.text:
Direction A "Neon orbit" (built out here and in the live site): near-black map, neon range rings with glow, frosted-glass panels, Unbounded display type, category icons, a radar sweep at the pin.
Direction B "Holo" (low-fi, bottom): the same components on light holographic gradients.

The basemap on these boards is a sketch; the real site uses OpenFreeMap vector tiles (open source, no API key).
